tbesh_html:
Teman = "south"
the region occupied by the descendants of Teman, located east of Idumea
Also named: te.ma.ni (תֵּימָנִי "Temanite" H8489)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Teman, the name of two Edomites, and of the region and descendant of one of them
strongs_1890.derivation: or תֵּמָן; the same as H8486 (תֵּימָן);
